dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Welcome, Traveler. Do you need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got some treasure I want to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: You want to sell treasure? That's quite a surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I imagine that an adventurer as skilled as you must have some truly rare goods to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Marjorie about the Dragonbone Orb.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Huh, isn't this what the bards called the "Fretnaught Fruit"?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: To think that it really exists... So its real name is the Dragonbone Orb.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: If its effects are as you say, I'd be willing to pay 80,000 Mora and some specialty dishes for it.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Hmm... How does 80,000 Mora and 5 Moon Pies sound to you?

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Hehe. I mean, it's such a unique treasure.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Why, it has abilities straight out of a fairy tale! I doubt those alchemists would be loath to part with their Mora.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: I'll take this, then. Thanks for your patronage!

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Ah yes. Such beads formed from condensation tend to evaporate slowly in the wind.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: As such, it might be best to cover it with a diaphragm or place it within a sealed container to ensure its quality.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: I'll give you this tip free of charge. Hopefully, it'll be of some use to you in your adventures.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: If you encounter such treasures in the future, always remember that you'll have a loyal buyer in me!

choices.text: Let me think about it a bit more.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: Sure, no problem. Nonetheless, I have confidence in my estimation of this item's value.

response.speaker: Marjorie
response.text: You can come to me again once you've mulled the matter over.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: How about it? Told you that my price was the best, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: If you sell it to me, my price is 80,000 Mora and 5 Moon Pies. Sounds reasonable, yes?
